# Canon rules

The build starts at [the Makefile](../../Makefile).

The parser lives at src/a/b.ts and runs through src/a/b.ts:12.

A decoy lives at src/xa/b.ts, and src/a/b.ts.old is a different file.
The word src alone in prose should not match a directory target.
